title.narrative: Accelerated implementation of end Tuberculosis strategies in Ethiopia - Ethiopia (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Ethiopia, Tuberculosis, Federal Ministry of Health of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FMOH)This program has the following goals: To contribute to the mission of the health sector by ending TB as a major public health problem in Ethiopia by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Address gaps in patient/client pathway.. Prevent TB infection and active disease.. Provide people-centered equitable and quality TB services.. Enhance bold policies and strengthen supportive systems.. Strengthen strategic information, research and innovations.
